Game Overview

Launch Jack is a halloween game built around catapult fearless pumpkin Jack through spooky landscapes in this thrilling physics-based adventure. Strategically navigate obstacles, unleash powerful combos, and deploy special power-ups to shatter zombie heads. As levels grow ever more challenging, aim skillfully to save Halloween and unwind the eerie enigma behind it all!
